_about: Z11: packets built or read by the GM ampersand commands. Offsets are payload offsets (after the opcode). Zone-ring packets start with ZONERINGLINKAGESTART { u8 machine, u16 handle, u32 regnum } (pdb2016).

number of addr entries (0 at the start, +1 per zone)
